olivia (people-ops): Quick drop 12: short, copyable goal + feedback snippets for Q3 cycle. Use in OKR drafts, 1:1s, or when asking for peer feedback.

olivia (people-ops): Manager goal stub (one-liner + measurables):
```
Goal: Improve inference throughput for chat-route by 18% via batching and kernel tweaks.
Why: supports higher concurrency for paid seats.
Success: 1) throughput +18% on synthetic suite; 2) p95 latency <= 200ms in prod canary; 3) rollout without >0.5% error increase.
```

olivia (people-ops): IC goal stub (brief):
```
Goal: Reduce memory per request for model-x by 15% through KV cache compaction.
Measures: perf bench delta, PR merged, monitors green at 5% traffic.
```

sam: These are great. Can we add a hiring/handoff line for goals that require new hires?

olivia (people-ops): Yep 12 small add-on: add a final line "Hiring/handoff: need headcount? role & ETA"

jules: Self-review micro-template? Managers always ask for concise evidence.

olivia (people-ops): Self-review (copyable):
```
- Top deliverable: one line + link to PR/epic
- Outcome: metric or user impact (one line)
- Challenge & learning: 1 line
- Next quarter focus: prioritize 1 thing + why
```

dan: Can we get a fast peer-feedback ask I can paste into slack?

olivia (people-ops): Peer ask (one-liner):
"Hey @NAME, quick favor: can you give 2 things I should KEEP doing and 1 thing I should CHANGE re: our work on PROJECT? One-line each, appreciate it!"

olivia (people-ops): Calibration note for managers: always include 1 guardrail metric (quality/regression) and mark which metrics are leading vs lagging. Prefer a mix of signal types.

sam: Manager coaching script for missed goals? Short please.

olivia (people-ops): Micro-coaching script:
```
1) Open: name one specific win.
2) Data: show baseline vs target, quick chart or #s.
3) Root cause: ask what blocked progress.
4) Support: offer concrete help (scope change, pairing, hire).
5) Next step: agree one action + date for follow-up.
```

jules: Throw in examples for stretch vs commit phrasing? People mis-label them.

olivia (people-ops): Examples:
- Commit: "Ship infra sharding to support 10k qps and keep p95 < 250ms."
- Stretch: "Explore model quantization to halve cost/token; aim for 40% improvement if feasible."

people-ops-bot: Reminder: mid-cycle check-ins due 2026-07-10. Submit notes here: https://intranet/reviews/checkins

olivia (people-ops): I'll bundle these into a one-pager and drop in the handbook + a Notion snippet. If anyone wants a Google Slides handout for managers, DM me. :slightly_smiling_face:

sam: Thanks olivia 12 small tweak: add a line about how to denote dependencies (e.g., "blocked by infra-team")

olivia (people-ops): Good call 12 added in the hiring/handoff line and will add a dependency field in the one-pager.
